fields.title: A contents-list jump in Page mode saves the page it lands on
fields.description: The view's API `goTo` counts as a turn in flight, so the relocate a TOC jump fires saves the landed page's first word and cfi through `onPageTurned`. That overwrites `handleJumpToChapter`'s early commit, which used the old page's cfi. `ReaderContainer.tsx` is not touched.
